NGI, July 21, 2011: 'FERC ... approved a request by ETC Tiger Pipeline LLC ... to place a 400 MMcf/d expansion of its system in service.' Exact match, independent outlet reporting the FERC order itself rather than the application.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded Capacity=400.00 MMcf/d for the Louisiana Expansion segment confirmed exactly by the FERC application and the FERC in-service order as reported by NGI.

verifications.note: FERC notice of application: filed 'pursuant to section 7(c) of the Natural Gas Act (NGA), and Part 157, Subpart A of the Commission's regulations' — an NGA Section 7 certificate is FERC's authorization instrument specifically for interstate natural gas transmission facilities.

ETC Tiger Pipeline, LLC's own 'FERC NGA GAS TARIFF, First Revised Volume No. 1,' with Rate Schedules FTS (Firm Transportation Service) and ITS (Interruptible Transportation Service) — an interstate transmission-service tariff, not a gathering or distribution filing.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded PipelineType=transmission confirmed by the pipeline's NGA Section 7(c) interstate certificate authorization and its own FERC transportation-service gas tariff — both regulatory instruments used only for interstate transmission pipelines.
